extracted.intended_audience: patent historians, trademark researchers, archivists, and trademark attorneys
extracted.subtask_description: An alphabetical index page from the 1877 United States Patent Office annual report listing trade-marks with columns for the article (invention/discovery), patentee, number, date, and Official Gazette reference. The page is a historical dataset intended to record trademark registrations/entries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Invention or discovery
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Column heading listing the product, good, or service associated with the trade-mark (examples on page: Brandy, Canned goods, Cigars, Coffee, Cosmetics, etc.). Used as the primary text field for each entry.

rubrics_metrics.name: Name of patentee
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Column heading listing the registrant/owner of the trade-mark (company or individual). Appears adjacent to the 'Invention or discovery' entry for attribution.

rubrics_metrics.name: No.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Column heading giving the registration/serial/patent number associated with the trade-mark entry (numeric identifier used to reference the record).

rubrics_metrics.name: Date
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Column heading showing the issuance/publication date for the trade-mark entry (formatted on the page as e.g. 'Feb. 13, 1877', 'July 17, 1877').

rubrics_metrics.name: Official Gazette
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Column heading giving the Official Gazette issue or page reference where the trade-mark was published or recorded; used for cross-referencing the official publication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Alphabetical ordering
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The index is organized alphabetically (by the 'Invention or discovery' column). This ordering is the organizing principle for locating entries across the index pages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Product/service grouping (implicit)
rubrics_metrics.description: Entries are presented by product/service headings and often show many similar items together (e.g., long runs of 'Cigars', 'Coffee', 'Paints').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Although not an explicit rule, the layout groups like items together which aids lookup and indicates topical clustering useful for indexing or categorization tasks.
